- The substrate appears to be a stem or similar tissue

- Branching conidiophore stalks with clusters of small round conidia at tips = classic Botrytis sporulation morphology
- Dense gray-brown velvety spore mass = matches "dense velvety gray-brown spore mass" description
- The dark black rounded mass in upper right = characteristic Botrytis sclerotium
- "spores are light brown-gray on black stalks" matches the coloring seen

This is a close-up microscopic view of Botrytis cinerea sporulation on plant tissue (likely a stem), which is definitively Gray Mold.
